questions: On the held-back track, at what progress and curvature does the robot leave the line, and is max_error still pinned at about 0.06 m?
Does line_loss_events fall to 0 on the tighter bends with the controller in place?
feedback_request.requested_changes_if_any: None. This is the final design; report any controller limit that is clearly geometric.

intent: Deliver the iteration 8 geometry unchanged as the final design. It is the best measured configuration (71.37 mean score; oval 86.4, s-bend 76.6, slalom 51.1). Yaw levers (mass, track) are at their minimums, and wheel radius 0.025 m and 0.034 m were both worse than 0.030 m. Expected result: a score close to 71 on development-like tracks, with the robot still leaving the line near the 0.06 m floor. The Integrator should tune the controller (gains, base_speed, sensor_weights, line_loss) on this platform.
learning: Across 11 iterations the largest gains came from sensor lead (y 0.05 to 0.07 m), seven-sensor span (±0.06 m), and lower mass (0.4 kg). Lower track width helped less. Wheel radius at 0.030 m was the best of the three values tested. Footprint at 16 mm did not help. Every measured run ends off track at the 0.06 m floor, so the remaining limit is controller response on this geometry.
rationale: This is the final iteration, so the delivered geometry is what the unseen-track race scores. The best measured design is iteration 8 (score 71.37): 0.4 kg mass, 0.08 m track, 0.03 m wheel radius, seven 12 mm sensors at 20 mm spacing (x = ±0.06 m), lead y = 0.07 m, body 0.18 x 0.12 m. Iterations 9 and 10 each changed wheel radius and both scored lower. Radius 0.025 m dropped the score by 1.65, and radius 0.034 m dropped it by 1.05 against iteration 8. Radius 0.034 m raised the oval (87.3 vs 86.4) but lowered the s-bend and slalom, which are closer to the unseen shape. Mass and track are already at their minimums, and sensor lead, span and footprint have all been tested. The off-track floor of 0.06 m is fixed, and body width cannot relax it. I therefore return the iteration 8 geometry unchanged rather than add an untested change to the final race. Every development run still ends off track near max_error 0.062-0.066 m, so this design is not a finished solution. It is the most robust measured platform for the Integrator's controller.
